title: Failures
description: The reasons a command of the review tool can fail. A failure carries no data and is made in code.

NotStarted.description: A sub agent could not be started

TooLarge.description: The change is over a limit

Refused.description: The change is not in a state to review

NotValid.description: What was given does not make a valid value

NotAssigned.description: The rule is not one of the probe's rules

NoPage.description: The surface has no page there

NotAcknowledged.description: The instructions are not acknowledged yet

WorkdirFailed.description: The workdir could not be read or written
